flags: Kept from the source: a doubled dumbbell outline for about 8 frames (0.27 s) at the fastest part of the lift, and again on the way down (the lowering is the lift reversed).
The lowering is the lift's own frames played backwards, so it takes as long as the lift (about 0.6 s); a slower, controlled lowering needs a new clip.
Only his left arm curls; his right-arm reps in the source had the elbow drifting forward and were cut.
Removed by the correction: the elbow drift (0.0-1.2 s, 4.6-5.6 s), the stitch between two takes at 3.9 s, the dumbbell smears at 5.8-6.4 s, and the light skin / olive shorts / lit backdrop (graded).
Tried and rejected: a crossfade loop (left a second faint dumbbell) and a motion-interpolated slow-down to 3.3 s (warped the dumbbell).
